data.description:
The data blob to put into the record, which is base64-encoded when the
blob is serialized.

partitionKey.description: Determines which shard in the stream the data record is assigned to.

sequenceNumber.description:
Each data record has a unique sequence number. The sequence number is assigned by Kinesis Data Streams after you
call {@link AwsKinesisStream#putRecord} to add the data record to the stream. Sequence numbers for the same partition key generally
increase over time; the longer the time period between PutRecord requests, the larger the sequence numbers become.
When puts occur in quick succession, the returned sequence numbers are not guaranteed to increase because the put
operations appear essentially as simultaneous to Kinesis Data Streams. To guarantee strictly increasing sequence
numbers for the same partition key, use this parameter
